name: Integration of Technology into Society
description:
AI agents are often predicted to be the next great advancement in digital technology. However, there’s considerable uncertainty about the nature of AI agents and how they can best complement human agency. 

This seminar builds on the rich philosophical discussion of agency to clarify fundamental questions about AI agents, including: What is an agent, and what constitutes agency? How do intentionality, consciousness, will, and understanding contribute to agency? Can AI systems be agents in their own right, or do they necessarily depend on human agency? What are their strengths and fundamental limitations? How can cooperation among agents create new forms of agency, and how can AI agents best complement human agency?

We’ll explore these and related questions through groundbreaking philosophical texts chosen by students from a curated list. Students can also suggest other texts that interest them. The seminar combines regular in-person meetings with exchanges involving SAP employees who work with AI agents in real business contexts.
